description: List your workspace's storefronts: each one's subdomain, name, whether it is published, what it lists (functions, products open to offers, tag and product filters), its own domains with their DNS records and status, and the addresses agents use (page, agent card, llms.txt, MCP). Also the limits and a suggested subdomain. A storefront is your own front door for agents at <subdomain>.last-price.ai or a domain you own. Only where the workspace has storefronts switched on (else an error with code not_released). Needs a Last Price credential with workspace settings read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: list_storefronts
